derived.causal_summary: Cyberpunk 2077 forces V and Johnny Silverhand to merge during the Relic storyline, and the merge cannot be declined in-game. Goal is to prevent the merge so V stays V while districts, side quests and Phantom Liberty remain reachable; if the merge cannot be blocked at its trigger, fall back to an alternative scripted resolution that removes Johnny instead of merging him. Phase 1 is investigation only, because the merge may be enforced in compiled engine code with no script hook.
